description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Benthicore, adding {C}{C}.
When Benthicore dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Benthicore from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Benthicore enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
